### CloudAgentCard

One Cursor cloud agent run, in the transcript of a thread on the cursor-cloud harness.

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | The agent's name, from the thread title. |
| `status` | `'CREATING' \| 'RUNNING' \| 'FINISHED' \| 'ERROR' \| 'CANCELLED' \| 'EXPIRED'` |  |
| `repo` | `string` | owner/name of the channel's GitHub repo. |
| `startingRef` | `string` | The branch it started from, when Cursor reported it. Not `ref`: React reserves that prop. |
| `branch` | `string` | The branch it pushed. |
| `prUrl` | `string` |  |
| `url` | `string` | The agent on cursor.com. |
| `mobile` | `boolean` | Phone layout: 20px radius, a little tighter. |
